content_identity: All 23 subject digests in final ContentState matched; Go 1.27.1 darwin/amd64 and macOS 26.7.2 match. Administrative review/status records excluded by original scope.
method: Go overlay injects a test file from private temporary storage; repository production, tests and configuration stay untouched. Each arm uses separate isolated source and SQLite fixtures.
root_cause: Batch excludes absent registered paths from changedPaths. Renamed source identity is resolved later, so moved-from session keys never enter before. Unexpected-key reconstruction then sees only post-move unchanged alternatives.
bounded_remediation: Resolve moved-from identities before collecting old keys and the before view, or fall back to the full before/after oracle when a batch contains a moved source. Add a priority-batch ownership-change regression.
verification_scope: No broader product rerun after decisive finding; previous broad results remain historical exact-state observations; native P10/P07 gaps remain open.
retention: Sanitized source and essential observations are self-contained here. Temporary overlay and logs are not durable references and will be removed.
